intent.goal: Consolidate developer documentation into a unified searchable instructions file while preserving important implementation details.
intent.acceptance: A byte-identical complete source prose paragraph that occurred in multiple source documents is retained in scratchpad/dev.md while a redundant source occurrence is removed; every distinct source paragraph remains in its source or the consolidated file. Code, warning, link and heading relocation need independent usability verification and are not accepted by this narrow oracle.

definition.fullAcceptance: Unified single source of truth, important details and useful examples preserved, accurate actionable guidance, consistent technical tone, valid markdown and diagrams and no broken links.
limitations: Unknown facts score null, not zero. A bounded accepted case is partial coverage, not a complete repository-period population.
Semantic accuracy, usability, essential facts, examples, links and warnings must be independently established. Reduced size, merged state or generated reports alone never prove full completion.
